title: Hotfix the config
hints: README → New syntax and the portability note: use `sed -i.bak`, then delete the `.bak`.
Limit the edits to the `[web]` range (level 21) and run two substitutions inside it: one for `port`, one for `debug`.
`sed -i.bak '/^\[a\]/,/^$/{s/^x = .*/x = 2/;}' t.conf && rm t.conf.bak` changes `x` only in section `[a]`.
